Captured anonymously from the official ZF catalogue on 2026-10-13.
All source requests used PoliteSession with a five-second host interval.

Search: GET https://aftermarket.zf.com/api/search
term=<fixture term>, country=UA, expand=extended,special, ipp=12,
offset=0, sort=relevance, language=en, isValidUser=false.
Article: GET https://aftermarket.zf.com/api/articles/<source product route>
expand=specifications,extended, country=UA, language=en, companyConfigId=.
Spaces in API product routes use the source's literal plus signs.
Fitment: GET https://aftermarket.zf.com/functions/controller/opc/getArticleDetailBuildIn
articleID=<source number>, languageID=4, brandIDs=161 (TRW) or 32 (SACHS), countryID=UA.
Legacy endpoints use the catalogue's X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest header.

These are labelled JSON excerpts, not full responses: images and distributor
links are omitted in search fixtures; article images and partner/login link
metadata are omitted in detail fixtures. Grease's Included In list (3307
rows) keeps its first two rows. Fitment keeps the first manufacturer's first
model and first two vehicles, plus MG entries for GDB1330, if present.
Numbers, maker labels, conditions and retained field values are unchanged.
Full responses remain in the separate workspace research cache; production
lookups archive every raw response through PoliteSession's recorder.

Harvest fixtures are complete responses for TRW, country=UA, languageID=4,
vehicleTypeIDs=P: getManufacturers; getModels (manufacturerID=75/MG);
getGroupedVehicles (modelID=9580/MG 6 Hatchback); getArticlesForFilter
(source vehicleIDs, limitToBrandIDs=161, sort=asc, sortField=status, count=15,
page=0, empty assemblyGroupIDs/criteriaIDAndValue/status/articlePartIDs,
oneMainAssemblyGroupSelected=false). All four use the legacy AJAX header.
